content: In principle, we could adopt any NMT and combine it with RAT. An NMT system directly models the conditional probability INLINEFORM0 of translating a source sentence, INLINEFORM1 , to a target sentence INLINEFORM2 . A basic form of NMT comprises two components: (a) an encoder that computes the representations or meaning of INLINEFORM3 and (b) a decoder that generates one target word at a time. State-of-the-art NMT models have an attention component that “searches for a set of positions in a source sentence where the most relevant information is concentrated” BIBREF4 .
